issues.description: Default range was '30d', violating AC-001 which requires the Overview page to show 'count of session completions in the last 7 days' on initial load. Fixed: changed fallback to '7d'.

iOS and Android validation error divs lacked role='alert', so dynamically injected errors were invisible to screen readers (WCAG 2.1 SC 4.1.3). Fixed: added role='alert' to both platform error containers.
issues.suggestion: Fixed — both platform error divs now carry role='alert'.

issues.description: A custom compareVersions function duplicated server-side logic, risking divergence from AppVersionService.compareVersions. Fixed: removed the local function and its usage in validatePlatform; version ordering is now validated exclusively by the backend.
issues.suggestion: Fixed — validatePlatform now only checks for empty fields; server returns 422 on ordering violations.

issues.description: 'Mark as Processed' button used min-h-[36px], below the project's established 44px touch-target minimum. Fixed: changed to min-h-[44px].
issues.suggestion: Fixed — min-h-[44px] now consistent with all other admin interactive elements.

issues.description: aria-live region was conditionally rendered; most screen readers do not announce live regions inserted into the DOM after page load. Fixed: the region is always rendered, its text content toggled instead.
issues.suggestion: Fixed — `{loading ? 'Loading...' : ''}` is always present in the DOM.

issues.description: CsvExportButton filename lacked an ISO 8601 date suffix required by AC-006. Fixed: appended the current date at the call site.

Error div had both role='alert' (implies aria-live='assertive') and aria-live='polite', creating conflicting semantics that can cause double-announcement in some screen readers. Fixed: removed redundant aria-live='polite'.

Debounce effect suppressed react-hooks/exhaustive-deps for pathname, router, and searchParams. If navigation occurred while the 300ms timer was pending, the stale closure would push a URL update to the old route. Fixed: refs track the latest navigation objects so the callback always reads current values.
issues.suggestion: Fixed — pathnameRef, routerRef, searchParamsRef kept current via separate effects; exhaustive-deps eslint suppression removed.

summary: All 8 issues from the prior review cycle have been resolved: the default range now correctly defaults to '7d' per AC-001, both platform error divs carry role='alert' for screen-reader accessibility, the duplicate compareVersions function is removed, touch targets are consistent at 44px, the aria-live loading region is always present in the DOM, the CSV export filename includes an ISO 8601 date, the conflicting ARIA attributes on the modal error div are cleaned up, and the debounce closure is hardened against stale navigation refs.
